name: Ribboned Bouquet Wrap
finished_size: About 12 cm long and 5 cm wide

yarn.description: Fine cotton or cotton-blend yarn for the wrap

additional_materials: 60 cm narrow satin or grosgrain ribbon
gauge: About 22 sc and 24 rows = 10 cm. Gauge is flexible, but the band should wrap comfortably around the gathered stems.

steps.label: Row 1
steps.text: Sc in the 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn.

steps.label: Row 2
steps.text: Ch 1, hdc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 3
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 4
steps.text: Ch 2, dc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 5
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 6
steps.text: Ch 1, hdc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 7
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 8
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in 3 sts, ch 2, sk 2 sts, sc in 18 sts, ch 2, sk 2 sts, sc in 3 sts; turn.

steps.label: Row 9
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in 3 sts, 2 sc in the ch-2 sp, sc in 18 sts, 2 sc in the ch-2 sp, sc in 3 sts; turn.

steps.label: Row 10
steps.text: Ch 1, hdc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 11
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 12
steps.text: Ch 2, dc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 13
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 14
steps.text: Ch 1, hdc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 15
steps.text: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.

steps.label: Row 16
steps.text: Ch 1, sl st in the first st, sc in the next 26 sts, sl st in the final st.

finishing: Fasten off after Row 16, leaving a 10 cm yarn tail.
Weave the yarn tail neatly through the reverse side of the band.
Lay the ribbon across the reverse side at the eyelet row. Feed one ribbon end through each ch-2 sp to the front, then adjust the tails to equal lengths.
Wrap the band around gathered bouquet stems and tie the ribbon tails into a bow on the front.
notes: The ch-2 spaces form ribbon eyelets; the ribbon holds the overlapping band snugly around the stems.
For a fuller bouquet handle, wrap the band around the stems twice before tying the ribbon.
